items.title: Hermes Agent Plugins Marketplace: One-Click Plugins for Hermes Desktop
items.content:
The Hermes Agent plugins marketplace lets you install community plugins into Hermes Desktop in one click — voice like Jarvis, a live news feed, job search, multi-device control and hundreds more, all free. In the video below I install a few live. Here’s how the marketplace works and the one check you must do before installing anything.

Key takeaways

The official plugin catalogue lives on the Hermes Agent docs site and inside Hermes Desktop’s capabilities section.
It has official and community plugins — around 500 when I recorded.
Click Open in Hermes Desktop, choose a profile, and install.
Always check the GitHub repo before installing a community plugin.






What the Hermes Agent plugins marketplace is
Nous Research launched an official plugin catalogue for Hermes Agent, which you can reach on the Hermes Agent docs site or in the capabilities section of Hermes Desktop. It started with a handful of official plugins and around a hundred community ones, and it has grown fast — I counted about 500 when I recorded.
Each listing shows its star rating, when it was last updated and its version, and you can filter by category — memory, voice, messaging, browsing, desktop panes and more. Nous says it reviews community plugins, and anyone can submit their own.
How to install from the Hermes Agent plugins marketplace

Browse the catalogue and open a plugin.
Click Open in Hermes Desktop, then Open Hermes.
Choose where it appears (for example, in the desktop UI) and which profile gets it.
Click Install — done.

I installed Hermes Newswire this way. In its settings I added a topic — “Hermes Agent” — searched for release notes, and within seconds there was a scrolling news feed along the bottom of my chats. You can add sources, change the speed, pause it or switch it off.

Want this working in your business, not just bookmarked? Customising Hermes Agent for your business is exactly what we build together inside the AI Profit Boardroom — 3,400+ members, four live calls a week, and a full one-hour DeepSeek Harness course in the classroom.
Prefer it mapped 1-on-1 first? Book a free strategy session and we’ll plan it for your exact situation.

Join the AI Profit Boardroom →Book a Free Strategy Session →

Best plugins I found in the Hermes Agent plugins marketplace




Plugin
What it does




Hermes Newswire
A live news ticker in Hermes Desktop — add topics like “Hermes Agent release notes” and sources, set speed, pause it


Hermes Tailscale
Connect and control Hermes across several devices over Tailscale


Voice plugins (speech, talk, live voice)
Talk to Hermes like Jarvis — install one, not all of them


Job search
Hyper-personalised job search that filters postings by what matters to you


Hermes Office 2
A visual office where you can watch your agents work


Platform gateways
WhatsApp, and even a Minecraft gateway


Search tools
Brave Search, Ollama Cloud web search and browser automations




You don’t need all of them. Pick the ones that fit how you work — and for categories with lots of options, like voice, I’d choose the one with the most stars.
Why plugins beat the old terminal setup
Before this, adding a capability to Hermes meant the terminal, config files and sometimes three hours on a GitHub skill that didn’t even work. Now it’s one click, and the ratings help you skip the dead ones. If you still want the manual route, each plugin page has its installation instructions and README.
For connecting apps like Gmail or Notion, see my Hermes Agent connectors guide — and for a solid base setup, my best Hermes setup walkthrough.
Check every plugin before you install it

Community plugins are open-source projects written by anyone. Check them before you install — a plugin runs with your agent’s access.


Open the GitHub repository before you install and read the README — what it does, what it needs access to.
Check the stars and last-updated date in the catalogue; abandoned plugins break.
Install into a test profile first — Hermes lets you choose which profile a plugin goes into.
Pick one plugin per job — one voice plugin, not five.
Never paste keys into a plugin you haven’t vetted.

Plugins vs skills vs connectors in Hermes




Type
What it is
Example




Plugin
Code that adds features to Hermes or Hermes Desktop
Newswire, Tailscale, voice


Skill
A set of instructions and scripts the agent follows for a task
An SEO audit procedure


Connector
A link to an outside app or account
Gmail, Notion, GitHub




Plugins change what Hermes itself can do; skills teach it how to do a job; connectors give it access to your apps. You’ll often use all three together. For memory specifically, see my Hermes memory plugins guide.
My starter set of Hermes plugins

One voice plugin — the most-starred one, so you can talk to Hermes hands-free.
Hermes Newswire — set to your niche, so news comes to you.
Hermes Tailscale — if you use Hermes on more than one device.
A search plugin — Brave Search is a good free option.
Hermes Office 2 — if you like seeing your agents work visually.

Five plugins, each solving one problem. Add more only when you have a specific need. Fewer plugins means fewer things to update and fewer things that can break.
How to remove or update a Hermes plugin
Plugins aren’t permanent. Each one has its own settings page in Hermes Desktop where you can switch it on or off without uninstalling it — handy for testing whether a plugin is causing a problem. If you don’t use a plugin any more, uninstall it rather than leaving it switched off.
Check the catalogue now and then for updates: the last-updated date tells you whether a plugin is still maintained. If Hermes starts behaving oddly after an update, switch off the plugins you added most recently one at a time until you find the culprit. Keeping a spare test profile makes all of this painless.
The bottom line on the Hermes Agent plugins marketplace
The Hermes Agent plugins marketplace makes Hermes Desktop feel like a brand-new app built exactly for you — free, one-click, and growing every week. Check the repo, test in a spare profile, and install only what you’ll actually use.
FAQ: hermes agent plugins marketplace
What is the Hermes Agent plugins marketplace?
The official catalogue of official and community plugins for Hermes Agent, browsable on the docs site and in Hermes Desktop’s capabilities section.
Are Hermes Agent plugins free?
The plugins in the catalogue are free; some connect to services that need their own account or API key.
How do I install a Hermes plugin?
Click Open in Hermes Desktop on the plugin’s page, choose a profile, and click Install.
Are Hermes community plugins safe?
Nous reviews community plugins, but always read the GitHub repo and README yourself and test in a spare profile first.
Can I submit my own Hermes plugin?
Yes — the catalogue has a submission link for developers.

items.title: Solar Mini 4 Hermes: How to Use It Free (and Avoid the Paid Version)
items.content:
Solar Mini 4 Hermes setup takes a few clicks, and right now Upstage’s new model is free inside Hermes Agent for a limited window. In the video below I set it up in Hermes Cloud, Hermes Desktop and Agent OS — and show the one setting you must get right, or you’ll end up on the paid version by accident.

Key takeaways

Solar Mini 4 is free in Hermes Agent for a limited time, from 5 October 2026.
It’s listed under the Free models in Nous Portal.
I give each model its own Hermes profile so I can switch fast.
Select the free version — the plain Solar Mini 4 entry is the paid one.






Why use Solar Mini 4 with Hermes
Solar Mini 4 is Upstage’s fast agent model — 3B active parameters out of 35B, 512K context — and Nous Research is offering it free in Hermes Agent for a limited time. My Solar Mini 4 overview covers the specs and benchmarks; this page is purely about getting it running in Hermes.
It’s not a frontier model, but for research, summaries and everyday agent tasks it’s fast and costs nothing.
Solar Mini 4 Hermes setup in Hermes Cloud

Go to Nous Portal’s cloud page and create an agent.
Scroll to the model section and click Free.
Choose Upstage Solar Mini 4.
Deploy — your Hermes instance now runs in the cloud on a free model.

You’ll see other free models in the same list, so you have backups ready.

Want this working in your business, not just bookmarked? Setting up Hermes Agent with free models is exactly what we build together inside the AI Profit Boardroom — 3,400+ members, four live calls a week, and a full one-hour DeepSeek Harness course in the classroom.
Prefer it mapped 1-on-1 first? Book a free strategy session and we’ll plan it for your exact situation.

Join the AI Profit Boardroom →Book a Free Strategy Session →

Solar Mini 4 Hermes setup in Hermes Desktop

Open Hermes Desktop and create a new profile — I name it after the model, “solar mini 4”.
Open the model settings and refresh the model list.
Edit the models and select Solar Mini 4 from the free models.
Send a test message — mine replied instantly.

Why a new profile? I keep one profile per model so I can switch and compare in seconds without breaking my main setup. You can use an existing profile if you prefer.
Using Solar Mini 4 in the Hermes dashboard or Agent OS
If you run the dashboard, type hermes dashboard in your terminal, open Models, choose Set main model, search “solar”, go to the Nous Portal section and pick the free Solar Mini 4. Inside Agent OS, add the Solar Mini 4 profile under Hermes and chat with it directly.

The setting that matters: in the model list there’s a free Solar Mini 4 and a paid one. Pick the version marked free. If you choose the other entry, you’re on the paid model.

Other free models and rate limits
Free models can get rate limited. If that happens, refresh the model list and switch to another free model. The free list in Nous Portal when I recorded included:

Upstage Solar Mini 4
Poolside Laguna XS 2.1
inclusionAI Ling 3.1 Flash and Ling 3.0 Flash
StepFun Step 3.7 Flash
Meituan LongCat 2.0

That’s why the one-profile-per-model setup is so useful — switching takes seconds.
Solar Mini 4 Hermes troubleshooting

Solar Mini 4 isn’t in the list — refresh the model list; new free models don’t always show until you do.
Unexpected charges — you’ve picked the paid entry. Switch to the free one under Nous Portal.
Rate limit errors — wait a few minutes or switch profile to another free model.
Memory is off — a new profile starts with memory switched off; turn it on in the profile settings if you want it.
Slow replies in Agent OS — check you’ve selected the Solar Mini 4 profile, not your default one.

What to use Solar Mini 4 for in Hermes
It handles basic agentic tasks well. The jobs I’d give it:

Daily AI news research and summaries
Researching competitors or topics before a piece of content
Turning notes and transcripts into structured outlines
Simple scheduled tasks that run every day

For hard coding or complex reasoning, switch profile to a frontier model like Claude Opus 5.5. That’s the whole point of one profile per model: the right brain for each job, one click apart. If you want more free options, my Ling 3.0 Flash guide covers another free model in the same list.
Why I keep one Hermes profile per model
It sounds like extra admin, but it saves me time every day. Each profile remembers its own model, settings and history, so switching from Solar Mini 4 to Claude Opus 5.5 or another free model is a single click — no digging through settings, no breaking the setup I rely on.
It also makes testing honest. When a new model drops, I create a profile, run the same task I ran on the others — my standard is “research the last seven days of AI automation news” — and compare the answers side by side. That’s how I decided Solar Mini 4 is good enough for everyday research but not for hard reasoning. When the free window closes, I simply switch that profile to the next free model.
Is Solar Mini 4 Hermes worth setting up?
Yes — it takes a couple of minutes, it’s fast, and it’s free while the window lasts. My research test came back quickly with a clear, well-sourced breakdown. Set up a Solar Mini 4 Hermes profile today and make sure you select the free version.
One more tip: note the date you set it up. Free windows end, and when this one does your Solar Mini 4 profile will stop answering or start charging. When that happens, open the profile and switch it to whichever free model is current.
FAQ: solar mini 4 hermes
How do I use Solar Mini 4 in Hermes?
Create a new Hermes profile, refresh the model list and select the free Solar Mini 4 from Nous Portal’s free models.
Is Solar Mini 4 free in Hermes?
Yes, for a limited time from 5 October 2026 — as long as you select the free version.
Why am I being charged for Solar Mini 4?
You probably selected the paid entry. Switch to the version marked free in the model list.
What if Solar Mini 4 is rate limited?
Refresh the model list and switch to another free model like Ling 3.1 Flash or Step 3.7 Flash.
Can I use Solar Mini 4 in Agent OS?
Yes — add your Solar Mini 4 Hermes profile in Agent OS, or set it as the main model in the Hermes dashboard.

items.title: Solar Mini 4: Upstage’s Fast 3B-Active Agent Model Explained
items.content:
Solar Mini 4 is Upstage’s new agent model — 35 billion parameters, only 3 billion active, a 512K-token context window, and right now you can use it free inside Hermes Agent. I tested it in the video below on a real research task. Here are the specs, the benchmarks, the price and my honest take.

Key takeaways

Solar Mini 4 is a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters, from South Korea’s Upstage.
It has a 512K context window and up to 128K output tokens.
It scored 24.1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.
Standard API pricing is $0.10/$0.40 per million tokens — and it’s free in Hermes Agent for a limited time.






What Solar Mini 4 is
Upstage is a South Korean AI company, and Solar Mini 4 is a model it pretrained from scratch specifically for agents — high-volume, repetitive work like retrieving information, producing structured output and calling tools, at low cost. Because it’s a mixture-of-experts model, only 3 billion of its 35 billion parameters are used for each token, which is why it’s so fast.




Solar Mini 4 spec

Architecture

Standard API price

Where to use it
Upstage Console API, Solar Chat, OpenRouter, Hermes Agent (free for a limited time)




Solar Mini 4 benchmarks
Upstage says Solar Mini 4 scored 24.1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index — the highest of the 3B-active models it compared against, and above models with around ten times the active parameters. Here are its other published scores:

Real SaaS workflow automation




Always test it on your own tasks — benchmarks published by the model maker are a starting point, not a verdict.

Want this working in your business, not just bookmarked? Using fast free models to run your AI agents is exactly what we build together inside the AI Profit Boardroom — 3,400+ members, four live calls a week, and a full one-hour DeepSeek Harness course in the classroom.
Prefer it mapped 1-on-1 first? Book a free strategy session and we’ll plan it for your exact situation.

How fast Solar Mini 4 is in practice
In my test I asked it to research the last seven days of AI automation news. It came back quickly with a tidy breakdown — sources, what stands out, the key stories. It even surfaced a launch I hadn’t seen. Upstage quotes 70+ tokens per second on two H100 GPUs.
Let me be 100% honest: this is not a frontier model. You won’t use it the way you use Claude Opus 5.5 for hard reasoning. But for basic agentic tasks — research, summaries, structured output — it’s more than good enough, and it’s fast.
Solar Mini 4 pricing and where to use it
Standard pricing is $0.10 per million input tokens, $0.01 per million cached input tokens and $0.40 per million output tokens, and Upstage ran a 70% launch discount until 10 October 2026. You can use it through the Upstage Console API, Solar Chat, OpenRouter, on-premises, and inside Hermes Agent.
The best deal right now: Hermes Agent users get it free for a limited window, which opened on 5 October. My step-by-step Solar Mini 4 Hermes guide shows exactly how to set it up — and the one setting that stops you landing on the paid version by accident.
Who should use Solar Mini 4

Hermes Agent users who want a fast free model for everyday tasks
Builders running lots of agent calls who care about cost per task
Long-document work — the 512K context fits huge inputs
Korean-language work — Upstage builds with native Korean in mind

If you need deep reasoning or complex coding, pair it with a frontier model and use Solar Mini 4 for the high-volume grunt work.
Solar Mini 4 vs other small agent models

Solar Mini 4’s edge is the combination of speed, a huge context window and a very low price, with strong tool use for its size. If you want open weights you can run yourself, look at Kolibri AI. If you want the fastest thing on a Mac, a tiny local model like LFM 2.5 is hard to beat.
Solar Mini 4 use cases I’d try

Daily news research — the exact test I ran in the video.
Summarising long documents — the 512K context swallows big PDFs and transcripts.
Structured data extraction — JSON mode and structured outputs are built in.
First-draft content briefs — fast and cheap to iterate.
Sub-agent work — let a frontier model plan, and Solar Mini 4 do the repetitive steps.

The pattern that works: give the cheap, fast model the high-volume tasks and save the expensive model for the decisions.
Getting the best results from Solar Mini 4
Small, fast models reward clear instructions. A few habits that help:

Be specific — say exactly what you want back, how long, and in what format.
Ask for structure — tables, bullet points or JSON play to its strengths.
Give it the source material — with 512K of context, paste the documents rather than relying on what it knows.
Check the facts — like any model, it can be confidently wrong, so verify anything important.
Escalate when needed — if it struggles on a hard problem, switch to a frontier model rather than re-prompting forever.

My verdict on Solar Mini 4
Solar Mini 4 is a fast, cheap, capable agent model, and while it’s free in Hermes there’s no reason not to try it. Just remember it can get rate limited — keep another free model ready to switch to.
